description:
# Supernova

Supernova is a mod that adds ships, weapons a factions and other such goodies for you all to enjoy.

Trade and interact with the **Nova Industries**, a friendly corporation that uses fast ships with strong shields but extremely weak armor and hull.

Fight against many tiny versions of your beloved ships, from the Astral and Onslaught to the [REDACTED]

Fight against interesting bounties, from greedy fuel traders to secret projects

I hope you have fun! This is my very first mod, so don't expect the highest of quality. Still, I'll work to improve the mod as much as i can!
